title: All is Burning
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that true freedom from suffering doesn't come from being detached or uninvolved with the world, but rather from understanding and embracing our interconnectedness with all things. The Buddha's teachings encourage us to cultivate a sense of awe and wonder at the complexity and impermanence of life, rather than trying to suppress or deny it. By letting go of our narrow, separate views of the world, we can develop a more nuanced and compassionate understanding of reality, which allows us to engage with the world in a more loving and engaged way. This means embracing the beauty and fragility of life, including its impermanence and potential for suffering, rather than trying to escape or avoid it.
